Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If you really really want to screw an Imbued deck then you should play
Corruptions.

Card Text:

+1 stealth action.
(D) Put a corruption counter on a minion controlled by your prey. If
the number of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds
the blood capacity of that vampire or the COST OF THAT ALLY, you may
burn all of your corrruption counters on that minion to gain control
of him or her.

Imbued are allies that have no cost. One Corruption counter is enough
to steal them.

So the following cards straight up wreck the imbued.

1. Contagion Action
2. Corruption Action
3. Form of Corruption Action
4. Reformation Action
5. Revelation of Desire Action Modifier
6. Revelation of Despair Reaction
7. Revelation of Wrath Combat
8. Sense the Sin Action Modifier
9. Venenation Action Modifier
10. Weigh the Heart Action Modifier

...brought to you courtesy of Library Monger.

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

From Lasombra's Imbued FAQ:

"Q) How does React with Conviction interact with corruption counters?

A) The corruption counter (from Corruption or Reformation or
Revelation of Despair/Wrath or Contagion) would be placed, as normal.
Then, when the option to take control is exercised (and canceled by
React with Convition), the effect of burning counters to take control
doesn't occur. Not because the counters are a cost, but because the
effect that would burn them is canceled. "

Messages.Author: CthuluKitty
Messages.Body:
> Imbued are allies that have no cost. One Corruption counter is enough
> to steal them.

Incorrect. Imbued do have a cost, which is conveniently represented by
the number in the green circle on the lower right hand of the card. It
is not a cost to recruit, but Corruption effects don't care what kind
of cost they're looking for, unlike Kindred Segregation.

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:


No, you are mistaken. Imbued have no cost. They have a starting life
which is also the amount of pool required to influence them into play.
If they had a cost then Kindred Segregation would be devastating.
Corruption effects do not about their starting life. It only cares
about the cost of the ally which in the case of Imbued is zero. One
corruption counter is all it takes to steal an imbued, period.
Mortals are notoriously easy to corrupt.

Unfortunately CK is right, here's the ruling from LSJ:

Screaming Vermillian wrote:
> What is an Imbused's cost to recruit? Nothing AFAIK. Their cost to
> bring them into play via their uncontrolled region != recruit cost.

Correct. Imbued are not recruited.

Kindred Segregation won't touch imbued and Orgy of Blood would get
X=0.

While corruption counter effects, Consume the Dead, and Khobar Towers
work with the ally's "cost" (not "cost to recruit") and will therefore
read the cost correctly.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <1189842183.0...@50g2000hsm.googlegroups.com>,

XZealot <xze...@cox.net> writes:
>...or maybe "cost" and "cost to recruit" are completely different
>terms now.

Of course they're different things.

Vampires have a cost. They do not have a cost to recruit.
An Assault Rifle has a cost. It does not have a cost to recruit.
Living Manse has a cost. It does not have a cost to recruit.

These don't have a cost to recruit because... *drum-roll*... they're not
recruited via a recruit action.

Shambling Hordes has a cost. This is also the cost to recruit, because
it's the cost paid for a recruit action.
